identity.fantasy: A radiant healer who combines direct Sunlight and Cascade recovery with Vows and Blessings that turn allies into healing or damage engines.
identity.one_line: Keep Bless on the priority ally, use Illumination, Shine and Daybreak for triage, and fulfill Vows for mana and amplification.

mechanics.core_loop: A conventional but buff-rich healer. Bless, Vows, Sunlight, Illumination, and Radiant Cascade cover steady and burst healing, while Solar Invigoration and Blessing of Triumph turn allies into healing or damage engines. Its core loop is more approachable than CoA's mode-switching healers.

modes.name: Holy Form
modes.structural_description: Ascend into a holy form, increasing your healing done by 10%, increasing your Holy critical strike chance by 5%, and reducing your threat generated by -50%.

modes.name: Empowered Holy Form
modes.structural_description: Doubles the effectiveness of your Holy Form.

mechanics.single_target: On durable targets, the structural path grows from Bless, Sunlight, An'she's Guidance toward Solar Priest, Blessing of Triumph, Empowered Holy Form. A precise priority remains limited to the captured build and community evidence.
mechanics.aoe: For multiple targets, Keep Bless on the priority ally, use Illumination, Shine and Daybreak for triage, and fulfill Vows for mana and amplification. The current evidence particularly constrains this through: Players report rough early mana and major improvement near 30 from Blessed-target refunds.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Hybrid range and conventional healing tools make movement relatively forgiving.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Bless, Sunlight, Sanctified, Blessing of Absolution, Faith.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Bless, Blessing of Absolution, Daybreak, Blessing of Purity, Stalwart.
